slides.heading: Aperture Priority
slides.subheading: You control depth — the camera controls motion.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Aperture Priority lets you control depth of field while the camera sets shutter speed automatically.
You choose the f‑stop; the camera adjusts shutter to maintain exposure.
You control depth — the camera controls motion.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: You choose the f‑stop; the camera adjusts shutter to maintain exposure.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Watch shutter speed to avoid motion blur.
Keep ISO low for clean images.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use Aperture Priority when lighting changes quickly but depth must stay consistent.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Letting shutter drop too low and introducing motion blur.
